thread:
Maya: ok handing over — quick summary of the afternoon incident and what I left live. TL;DR: partial KV-cache eviction on us-west that caused elevated p95 for small-chat routes, automatic fallback enabled, customer impact mostly 502s for heavy-concat jobs. see below for details and remaining actions.

Maya: timeline in short: 15:04 start of anomaly (eviction churn), 15:12 first pages, 15:19 automatic fallback to model-variant-b enabled, 15:40 mitigation (throttle + aggressive prewarm) reduced error volume, 15:58 steady but still elevated latencies for a subset.

IncidentBot: [ALERT] paged @Maya @Andre at 2026-06-18T15:12:07Z — symptom: downstream 502/504 on llm-small-chat routes, sproc error: kv_get timeout. Relevant pager: https://incidents.redwood.dev/INC-2026-245

Priya: thanks for the recap. customers affected: two enterprise tenants saw ~7% request error rate for ~35 minutes. sales flagged one support case (CS-879) but no major revenue-impacting pages.

Maya: mitigation details I applied while on call:
- Enabled variant fallback for small-chat -> model-variant-b (less KV reliance).
- Set per-route soft-throttle to 150r/s for affected routes.
- Triggered cache prewarm on 6 nodes in us-west staging pool via the ops job: `./tools/prewarm --region us-west --nodes 6 --pattern small-chat`
- Temporarily raised eviction_threshold to 82% on the affected hosts (manual patch) — this is temporary, revert scheduled by next run.

Jenna: logs excerpt I dropped into the incident ticket:
```
[15:07:03] kvcache.eviction throttle=1.0 host=gw-34 err=evict-loop
[15:08:41] batcher.queue depth=128 route=small-chat p95=1.8s
[15:11:59] rpc.kv_get timeout host=gw-38 id=0x7f2c
[15:15:20] fallback.trigger model=model-variant-b session=abcd1234
```

Carlos: observed that the embedding-autoscaler spiked coupling to the same hosts — looks like collateral load. I've pinned autoscaler to new pool for now, will open a follow-up to decouple embedding warmups from primary serving machines.

Maya: current status at handoff:
- Error rate: ~0.5% (down from 7%)
- p95 for small-chat: 550ms (was 1.8s at peak)
- Fallback: still enabled, autoswitch policy set to manual revert
- Affected region: us-west only (multi-region fallback held traffic in eu/us-east)
- Customer impact: support cases created; CS & AE notified.

Andre: I'll be primary for the next 8 hours. My checklist on takeover:
1) Confirm fallback policy remains healthy and not causing quality regressions. quick smoke with `curl` against small-chat with sample prompt.
2) Watch for eviction churn in the host-level dashboard (link below).
3) Coordinate with infra to schedule controlled revert of eviction_threshold once safe.
4) If error rate rises above 2% or p95 > 1s, escalate to oncall-sre and consider scaling an extra 12 GPUs as emergency capacity.

Maya: runbook pointers I used:
- KV Cache Eviction playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/kv-eviction (steps 1-4 executed)
- Fallback & Variant switch playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/fallbacks
- Customer comms template: https://docs.redwood.dev/templates/customer-incident-email

Priya: gap notes: there is a monitoring blindspot for cross-service warmup on the embedding autoscaler; it didn't fire an internal alert when it overlapped with evictions. action: file an observability ticket.

Jenna: I've assigned the postmortem owner: @Carlos will lead. Outline in incident ticket: scope, root cause hypothesis (eviction + embedding warmup collision), mitigation timeline, and residual actions. Carlos please add ETA for postmortem draft.

Carlos: taking PM. I'll have a first draft in 48 hours (June 20 COB). Immediate follow-ups I'll create: OB-145 (decouple embedding autoscaler warmups), INF-502 (revisit eviction thresholds + autoscaling signal), DOCS-77 (update runbook with clearer revert steps).

Andre: operational notes for night shift:
- Primary: Andre (me)
- Secondary: Priya (overnight backup)
- Coverage gap: 02:00-04:00 PDT short on warmup-ops (we don't have scheduled warmup then) — avoid scheduled large rollouts in that window; I've added a `no-rollout` flag to the calendar.
- Oncall contacts: infra-ops channel pinned, paging policy unchanged.

Maya: things I'm leaving for you:
- Revert eviction_threshold when you confirm stable p95 for 2 hours.
- Confirm the prewarm job completed successfully on all 6 nodes (logs at https://logs.redwood.dev/search?job=prewarm&run=2026-06-18T15).
- Coordinate with CS for the customer summary message (I drafted one in CS-879).

Priya: quick Q — do we want automatic revert of fallback after 24h? that could flip quality for some customers.

Andre: prefer manual revert. add a note to incident ticket: `fallback_auto_revert: false` and require manual QA.

IncidentBot: [ACTION] created tasks: OB-145 INF-502 DOCS-77 linked to INC-2026-245.

Maya: final notes: no current pages expected, but keep eyes on us-west batcher/p95 and kv_get timeouts. If anything flares, page SRE immediately. Good handoff, Andre — ping me if you need handover-swap later. :thumbsup:

Andre: got it, thanks Maya. taking first watch now.

Jenna: added runbook section 'prewarm verification' to the runbook draft. :white_check_mark:

Carlos: I'll post the initial postmortem outline in INC-2026-245 within the hour and tag the stakeholders.

Andre: logging takeover note in ops log: `takeover_by=Andre ts=3400001234 status=watch`

Maya: thanks team — handing over.
